# Ryan Kroge — SBA Loan Specialist

> Ryan Kroge is a Detroit-based SBA loan specialist with 25+ years of experience structuring SBA 7(a) and 504 loans for business owners nationwide.

## Services

- SBA 7(a) and 504 loan structuring
- Business acquisition financing
- Strategic financial guidance
